name: Accounting
overview: Accounting is the recording of financial transactions, as well as their storage, sorting, retrieval, summarization, and presentation in different reports and analyses. The discipline has evolved from basic record-keeping to a sophisticated field leveraging advanced technologies and specialized expertise. Modern accounting encompasses financial, managerial, tax, and sustainability accounting while professionals provide strategic guidance on financial matters and compliance.

topJobs.description: Assess financial health and provide insights for investment decisions through analysis of financial accounts and market research.
Experts in tax planning and compliance who help minimize tax liabilities while ensuring adherence to tax laws.
Oversee financial operations including reporting, budgeting, and maintaining internal controls in large organizations.
Professionals offering financial statement audits, tax planning, and consulting services across various sectors.

institutesIndia: Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI)
institutesInternational: London School of Economics and Political Science (LSE), United Kingdom
careerLadder: Focus on academics during high school (mathematics, economics, business studies)
Pursue undergraduate degree in accounting or related field with internship participation
Obtain professional certifications (CPA, CA, ACCA, CMA)
Complete Master's degree in Accounting or specialized area
Take standardized exams (GRE/GMAT) for advanced program admission
Combine academic excellence, practical experience, and continuous professional development
